title: The Purified Ones And Verifying Scholars Proof Through Demonstrations

questions.question: Where did the traveler go after leaving the gathering of the prophets?
questions.answer: He went to the classroom of truthful scholars.

questions.question: What did these scholars do about the prophets’ message?
questions.answer: They showed that it is true with strong proofs.

questions.question: What big faith truths did the scholars explain?
questions.answer: They explained that Allah exists and that Allah is One.

questions.question: About how many scholars did the traveler see there?
questions.answer: He saw very many, including thousands of brilliant people and hundreds of thousands of learned scholars.

questions.question: Why is their agreement important?
questions.answer: Because many wise people agreed on the same faith truths.

questions.question: Did all of the scholars think in exactly the same way?
questions.answer: No. They were different, but they still agreed on the main beliefs.

questions.question: What did each scholar have for his belief?
questions.answer: Each one had a sure and strong proof.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does a denier show by fighting such clear proofs?
questions.answer: He shows deep ignorance and stubbornness.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the example about closing one’s eyes in daytime?
questions.answer: A person cannot change the truth, only hide it from himself.

questions.question: For how long had the scholars’ light been shining on much of the world?
questions.answer: For more than a thousand years.

questions.question: How much of the world had their light reached?
questions.answer: About half of the globe.

questions.question: What kind of strength did the traveler find in that classroom?
questions.answer: He found strong moral and spiritual power.

questions.question: Could the people who deny faith break that power?
questions.answer: No. Their combined strength could not shake it.

questions.question: What is the main lesson of this passage?
questions.answer: The united proofs of truthful scholars strongly support belief in Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: Who invited the traveler into a new classroom?
questions.answer: Purified and very truthful scholars invited him.

questions.question: How are these scholars described in the passage?
questions.answer: They are deep thinkers, original, careful, and truthful.

questions.question: What were the scholars proving?
questions.answer: They were proving the truths of faith.

questions.question: Which two faith ideas are named first among those truths?
questions.answer: Allah’s existence and Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What was special about their proofs?
questions.answer: Their proofs were so strong that they left no doubt.

questions.question: Even though the scholars were different from each other, what did they share?
questions.answer: They shared the same basic beliefs.

questions.question: What does their agreement itself become?
questions.answer: It becomes evidence for the truth.

questions.question: What would have to happen for someone to fairly doubt all of them?
questions.answer: A person would have to think so many smart people could all reach the same result wrongly.

questions.question: How does the passage describe someone who rejects these clear proofs?
questions.answer: As ignorant and stubborn.

questions.question: What kind of matters is the denier being stubborn about?
questions.answer: About negative claims against the faith.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the picture of a person shutting his own eyes?
questions.answer: Refusing to see truth does not remove it.

questions.question: What had these scholars’ teachings done for a long time?
questions.answer: They had spread light for more than a thousand years.

questions.question: What short statement sums up the scholars’ lesson?
questions.answer: Their united and certain proofs point to Allah alone.

questions.question: What good thing did the traveler taste through belief before entering the scholars’ classroom?
questions.answer: He tasted a high and beautiful truth.

questions.question: Whose claims did the scholars support?
questions.answer: They supported the claims of the prophets.

questions.question: What did the traveler notice when he entered the classroom?
questions.answer: He noticed huge numbers of brilliant and learned scholars.

questions.question: What were these scholars using to teach faith?
questions.answer: They were using deep and clear demonstrations.

questions.question: How clear were those demonstrations?
questions.answer: They were clear enough to leave no doubt.

questions.question: Did the scholars all have the same abilities and viewpoints?
questions.answer: No. They differed in ability and outlook.

questions.question: Why does their agreement matter even more because of those differences?
questions.answer: Because different people still reached the same true result.

questions.question: What kind of proof did every one of them have?
questions.answer: A firm and certain proof.

questions.question: If a person rejects all of them, what is he really doing?
questions.answer: He is choosing ignorance and stubbornness.

questions.question: What does the passage say a person can do only for himself by shutting his eyes?
questions.answer: He can make it seem dark only to himself.

questions.question: What had been shining from this classroom for over a thousand years?
questions.answer: The scholars’ light.

questions.question: What kind of power did the traveler feel there?
questions.answer: He felt spiritual and moral strength.

questions.question: What was stronger than the strength of all deniers put together?
questions.answer: The force found in that classroom of scholars.

questions.question: After the prophets, what group taught the traveler next?
questions.answer: A group of purified scholars taught him.

questions.question: What made these scholars trustworthy in the passage?
questions.answer: They were very truthful and used powerful proofs.

questions.question: What were they all in agreement about?
questions.answer: They agreed on the main parts of belief.

questions.question: What are two main parts of belief named in this passage?
questions.answer: That Allah exists and that Allah is One.

questions.question: Why is it important that so many smart scholars agreed?
questions.answer: It shows the truth is very strong and clear.

questions.question: Did their different backgrounds stop them from agreeing?
questions.answer: No. They still agreed on the faith.

questions.question: What does the passage say about someone who denies their shared conclusion?
questions.answer: That person acts with ignorance and stubbornness.

questions.question: What does the example of day and night teach?
questions.answer: Truth does not change just because someone will not see it.

questions.question: How long had the scholars’ light continued?
questions.answer: It had continued for over a thousand years.

questions.question: How far had that light spread?
questions.answer: It had spread across half the world.

questions.question: What could not destroy the strength found there?
questions.answer: All the deniers together could not destroy it.

questions.question: What does the final Arabic-and-English summary point to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s necessary existence and unity through the scholars’ agreement.

questions.question: What happened to the traveler because of the power of belief?
questions.answer: He was led to another lesson about truth.

questions.question: What kind of place did he enter in this part?
questions.answer: He entered a classroom of purified scholars.

questions.question: What was the job of these scholars in the passage?
questions.answer: Their job was to prove the truths of faith.

questions.question: Which faith truths did they especially prove?
questions.answer: They especially proved Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: How did they prove these truths?
questions.answer: They proved them with strong and careful arguments.

questions.question: What does it show when many scholars agree on the same pillars of belief?
questions.answer: It shows the beliefs rest on strong truth.

questions.question: Why is their agreement even more meaningful?
questions.answer: Because they were not all the same in thinking and ability.

questions.question: What did each scholar stand on?
questions.answer: Each scholar stood on certain proof.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the weak response of a denier?
questions.answer: The denier responds with ignorance and stubbornness.

questions.question: What happens when someone refuses to see the truth?
questions.answer: He harms only himself.

questions.question: What had the scholars’ light done over many years?
questions.answer: It had lit up much of the world.

questions.question: What did the traveler discover in this classroom that deniers could not defeat?
questions.answer: He discovered a strong spiritual force.

questions.question: What is one big message from this classroom scene?
questions.answer: True scholars help people believe in Allah with clear proofs.

questions.question: Who were the teachers in this passage?
questions.answer: The teachers were purified and truthful scholars.

questions.question: What relation did these teachers have to the prophets?
questions.answer: They supported and confirmed the prophets’ message.

questions.question: What did the traveler see in their classroom?
questions.answer: He saw many brilliant and honored scholars.

questions.question: What kind of subjects were they teaching?
questions.answer: They were teaching the truths of faith.

questions.question: What two truths are named at the front of their teaching?
questions.answer: Allah’s necessary existence and His unity.

questions.question: How strong were the scholars’ proofs?
questions.answer: They were very strong and left no room for doubt.

questions.question: What is surprising about the scholars’ agreement?
questions.answer: They agreed even though they had different ways of thinking.

questions.question: Why does the passage treat this agreement as a proof?
questions.answer: Because many wise people reaching the same truth is powerful evidence.

questions.question: What does the passage say about denying such a proof?
questions.answer: It says denial comes from ignorance and stubbornness.

questions.question: What does the image of shut eyes help us understand?
questions.answer: It helps us understand that refusing truth does not erase it.

questions.question: For how long had the classroom’s light been shining?
questions.answer: For more than a thousand years.

questions.question: Where had that light reached?
questions.answer: It had reached half of the earth.

questions.question: What kind of power was in that classroom?
questions.answer: There was moral and spiritual power in it.

questions.question: What final truth do the scholars’ united proofs point to?
questions.answer: They point to Allah alone.
